name: Dongfeng Electronic Technology Co.,Ltd.
summary: Dongfeng Electronic Technology Co.,Ltd. is a Chinese enterprise dedicated to the research, development, procurement, manufacturing, and distribution of a diverse range of automotive parts and accessories. Its comprehensive product portfolio includes essential automotive systems such as instrumentation, interior trim, braking mechanisms, and fuel supply. The company also specializes in advanced electronic solutions, offering GPS car navigation system components, body controllers, and complete cockpit modules. Additionally, it produces sensors, various other component parts, plastic fabrications, and non-ferrous metal die castings, serving the automotive, motorcycle, and other related industries. Founded in Shanghai, China, in 1997, the company operates as a subsidiary of Dongfeng Motor Parts & Components Group Co., Ltd.
